title: A judgment's Req follows a workspace barrel import to the declaring function: editing that helper or re-pointing the barrel stales the guard, editing another re-export does not

assert.why: A.7.5.1 rule 9: unestablished does not block at normal under DefaultPolicy

A.12.2.10: u's import of h through the workspace barrel lib/src/index.ts resolves to the declaring identity lib/src/h.ts#h, which the manifest records as u's ref; A.5.3.4 [D4]: Req for a judgment adds the functions of comp(u) reachable through Refs°, so h@unit is in Req and its moved digest stales the judgment (A.5.4.1), introduced since Req meets Δcode (A.7.3.3)
A.5.3.4: k, re-exported by the same barrel but not imported by u, is not reachable through Refs°, so Req = {u, h} is unchanged and the judgment stays usable

A.12.2.10, A.5.7.2: re-pointing the barrel changes what u's import resolves to, so u's unit digest (env by identity) moves and its ref becomes h2; Req = {u@unit, h2@unit}, which the base judgment does not cite, so stale (A.5.4.1 'Req partly uncited'), introduced (A.7.3.3)
